_readme: Copy the parts you need into data/overrides.json. The catalog re-reads that file whenever it changes, so you can edit it during the demo. 'offers' patches any Offer field returned by price_and_availability; 'products' patches any Product field returned by get_product. Remove an entry to undo it.
